correctness.evidence: 11 Mac-verified serial gates. 66 requests and 3,076,480 signed-score comparisons, including diagnostic and warm-up work.

limitations: One boot and one resident load. Three paired blocks are descriptive.
The extra digest and timing probes belong to the stock verification diagnostic only.
The 20 Hz INA260 observer was applied to both A/B arms. Its earlier qualification used a different block geometry.
Energy is measured on VCC_SOM. The 10 mW count step is not a calibrated accuracy estimate.

protocol.measurement_boundary: Admission through the full validated board receipt. Generation interval uses the resident loop alone.
protocol.quality_gate: Exact signed scores, output bytes, EOS and counters per request, independently verified compact receipts.
protocol.tokenizer: BOS plus two hexadecimal digit IDs per input UTF-8 byte. Output uses byte IDs and EOS.
protocol.warmup: Three exact warm-up requests per arm in one resident session.
